text:
mia (Sales): Quick sync — Prospect (FinHealth Corp) wants an on-prem, air-gapped POC. Requirements: no outbound telemetry by default, bundle delivered via customer's jumpbox only, signed artifacts + SBOM, offline license activation, and a tight upgrade window (they can only accept upgrades during a 2-week maintenance period every quarter). Can we support this end-to-end? Any red flags?

alex (Eng-Platform): We can support signed immutable bundles + SBOMs. Main callouts: delta vs full bundle updates. Deltas are doable but add complexity to the apply path in air-gapped setups. Also need to confirm whether the jumpbox allows outbound pull or if they will push the artifact into the environment.

rahul (Eng-Infra): Jumpbox model is fine. Typical flows we support: customer SFTP pull, scp from jumpbox, or vendor-provided signed tarball dropped into a controlled bucket. For offline activation we support license token files signed by our CA — no live callbacks required. HSM/KMS integration is supported for Private installs if they want to manage keys locally.

sarah (Security): Telemetry: we cannot ship runtime telemetry without explicit opt-in. For support we can provide an offline support bundle that they upload to a secure portal or transfer via a jumpbox. Also need clarification on logs — will they accept redacted logs or insist on full capture? That impacts what support we can provide without remote access.

mia (Sales): Pricing Q — they want a 3-month POC, no Dedicated reservation. What's our standard POC commercial? Any special entitlements for air-gapped?

alex (Eng-Platform): POC model: time-limited license + limited support hours. Commercial usually: nominal POC fee (covers packaging/signing + SRE support during cutover) or discounted monthly licensing if they prefer. For air-gapped/offline we typically charge a one-time packaging/engineering fee for creating signed bundles and SBOM attestations. I'll loop in sales-ops for exact numbers.

legal-bot: Security questionnaire item flagged: "Will we provide source code or build artifacts?" Short answer: binaries and signed artifacts only; source access requires an explicit enterprise dev agreement.

rahul (Eng-Infra): Upgrade cadence: recommend quarterly or on-demand with agreed windows. For POC we can do a single upgrade/patch during the agreed 2-week window. Weekly patch cadence is not realistic for air-gapped setups unless we set up dedicated engineering capacity. Also need to define rollback plan for failed upgrades.

mia (Sales): They also asked: can installs be rekeyed offline? They need the ability to rotate keys without outbound access.

alex (Eng-Platform): Yes — offline rekey via signed key material is supported, but requires coordination with our entitlement team to produce a signed rekey token. We'll need to document the process in the runbook.

sarah (Security): On SBOMs: we can provide SPDX-formatted SBOMs and sign them. We can also provide SLSA-style attestations on request. We should confirm CVE notification expectations — we notify customers but without telemetry we can't proactively surface affected instances. They must run scans locally or allow periodic attestation uploads.

mia (Sales): Action items: I need a short runbook I can send to the customer today with jumpbox flow + offline activation steps + estimate of bundle size. @alex can you draft runbook? @rahul can you estimate package sizes for quantized models? @sales-ops can you provide POC pricing + packaging fee? Need to respond by EOD.

alex (Eng-Platform): Will draft a short runbook. Example provisioning flow I'll include: 1) We deliver signed artifact named redwood-pkg-2026.03.20.tar.gz with SHA256 and signature. 2) Customer pulls via jumpbox scp. 3) Install: sudo redwood-installer --verify <file> --install-dir /opt/redwood. 4) Offline license activation: sudo redwood-activate --license /tmp/license-token.json. I'll include rollback steps and checksum verification.

rahul (Eng-Infra): Bundle size estimates (rough): base runtime ~1.2GB, quantized LLM weights ~600MB, runtime deps + python venv ~400MB. Full offline bundle w/ deps ~2.5GB. Delta patch size depends on model change: minor weight deltas ~20-80MB, larger model upgrades ~200-600MB. If they want minimal transfer sizes we can recommend quantized models and separate model blobs.

sales-ops: We can offer: 3-month POC pricing = one-time packaging fee (engineering + SBOM/signing) + discounted license for duration. I'll draft numbers shortly.

sarah (Security): Also add to runbook: verification commands and what to send to support. We need them to provide the signed manifest and install log bundle if they want support — we cannot remote in.

deploy-bot: Release artifact redwood-pkg-2026.03.20 signed (sha256: abc123...efg) — tag: airgap-poc-2026.03

mia (Sales): Great — thanks all. I'll compile and send. One last ask from the customer: can we include a short SLA for POC uptime and a statement about data residency (data never leaves their network)? Simple yes/no items help their security team.

alex (Eng-Platform): SLA for POC: best-effort with specified support hours; we can add a focused SLO for install/upgrade support during the agreed window. Data residency: yes — data remains on their network unless they explicitly opt in to upload support bundles.

mia (Sales): Perfect. I'll send a consolidated reply. If anyone has any small notes to add to the runbook, drop them here. :pray:
